hero.title: Firebolt 9 Intents Specification
hero.description: Intent definitions for applications to request device and content experiences through the RDK9 video platform

blocks.body: An Intent is a message object sent to an application requesting a specific action. This may occur as part of the launch of the application or when it is already loaded. The application shall treat the receipt of an intent as an explicit request to carry out the intent and immediately action it, irrespective of what the application is currently doing. The only exception to this if the application is carrying out some process that can not be interrupted eg processing a payment.

An application may support multiple intent action types or none, however if an application receives an intent that it does not support, or one that does not contain enough data for an application to fulfil it, it shall ignore it and not present any error to the user.

rows.description: A string specifying the implicit action being requested to be performed
An optional object that contains data to be used by the application in order to fulfil the action

intent-home.heading: Home action type
intent-home.overview: A request to action a transition to the home page of the application

blocks.body: The Home action intent does not require a data object

intent-launch.heading: Launch action type
intent-launch.overview: A request to show the page the app was previously on (or Home page if it's a cold launch) of the application

rows.name: dialPayload
rows.description: The optional DIAL payload

rows.name: additionalData Url
rows.description: The optional DIAL URL which allows the first screen application to POST data back to the second screen application

intent-pre-load.heading: Pre-Load action type
intent-pre-load.overview: A request to pre load the application, but indicates that it will not immediately be activated and is likely to be transitioned into the suspended/hibernated

blocks.body: The Pre-load action intent does not require a data object

intent-entity.overview: A request to action a transition to the entity/show page of the specified entity

rows.name: seriesId

rows.name: appContentData

rows.name: programType
rows.description: An optional indicator of the type of the programme eg 'movie'

rows.name: entityType
rows.description: An indicator of the entity type

intent-playback.heading: Playback action type
intent-playback.overview: A request to action a transition into the playback of the specified entity

rows.name: entityId

rows.name: assetId
rows.description: The identifier of the asset, in the target App's scope.

intent-search.heading: Search action type
intent-search.overview: A request to action a transition to search page of the application, prefill the search box with the supplied query string and initiate the search

rows.name: query
rows.description: The query string to be seeded in the search box

intent-section.heading: Section action type
intent-section.overview: A request to action a transition to the specified section of the app using the additional data if supplied

rows.name: sectionName
rows.description: The section name, in the target App's scope.

rows.name: appContentData
rows.description: Additional information for the app to present the correct content

intent-tune.heading: Tune action type
intent-tune.overview: A request to action a tune to the specified linear channel, with optional offset options from the live point

rows.name: entityId
rows.description: ID of the channel, in the target App's scope.

rows.name: assetId
rows.description: The ID of a specific 'listing', as scoped by the target App's ID- space, which the App should begin playback from.

rows.name: restartCurrentProgram
rows.description: Denotes that the App should start playback at the most recent program boundary, rather than 'live.'

rows.name: time
rows.description: ISO 8601 Date/Time where the App should begin playback from.

intent-play-entity.heading: Play-Entity action type
intent-play-entity.overview: A request to start playback of the specified playlist, optionally starting from a specific track

rows.name: playFirstId
rows.description: The Id of the asset in the playlist to play first, in the target App's scope.

rows.name: playFirstTrack
rows.description: The track number in the playlist to play first

intent-play-query.heading: Play-Query action type
intent-play-query.overview: A request to start playback of a playlist created by a search

rows.name: query
rows.description: The query to be used to select the content to be played

intent-previous.heading: Previous action type
intent-previous.overview: A request to action a transition to the previous media asset in a playlist or series

blocks.body: The Previous action intent does not require a data object

intent-next.heading: Next action type
intent-next.overview: A request to action a transition to the next media asset in a playlist or series

blocks.body: The Next action intent does not require a data object

intent-repeat.heading: Repeat action type
intent-repeat.overview: A request to replay the current media asset

blocks.body: The Repeat action intent does not require a data object

intent-shuffle.heading: Shuffle action type
intent-shuffle.overview: A request to start playing randomly another media asset in a playlist or series

intent-skip-ad.heading: Skip-Ad action type
intent-skip-ad.overview: A request to skip the current advertisement block
